note: SPTAN1 is established as the causative gene for autosomal dominant dHMN11 with classic dHMN features where tremor is generally infrequent compared to disorders like dHMN-V.

evidence.text: The review categorizes SPTAN1 as an autosomal dominant cause of classic dHMN, contrasting it with phenotypes presenting with prominent tremor or cerebellar involvement.
